name: Justice
drive_trigger: When you do the right thing instead of the easy thing.
steady: Edge on rolls to stop someone hurting an innocent.
hook: You won't let a guilty person walk, even when chasing them costs the team.
breaking: You go after the guilty party alone, ignoring orders and danger.

name: Vengeance
drive_trigger: When you go after someone who hurt you or yours.
steady: Edge against anyone who has hurt you this Night.
hook: You can't let them get away.
breaking: You go too far. The GM asks how far, and you answer honestly. Take +1 Heat.

name: Mercy
drive_trigger: When you risk yourself to save someone, even an enemy.
steady: When you Help an ally, they get Advantage instead of Edge.
fraying: Clear 1 Stress whenever you pull someone out of danger.
hook: You can't leave anyone in danger, enemies included.
breaking: You automatically take every hit aimed at anyone in your zone until the scene ends.

name: Spite
steady: When someone hurts you, your next attack on them has Edge.
fraying: Whenever you take Harm, your attacker takes 1 Stress.
hook: You can't back down from an insult or a challenge.
breaking: You attack whoever is closest, friend or foe.

name: Order
drive_trigger: When the team follows a plan you made.
steady: When you lay out a plan, name one step of it. The roll for that step has Edge, whoever makes it. Once per scene.
hook: When the plan falls apart, you have Disadvantage until you spend a Full Action making a new one.
breaking: You freeze or double down on a plan that's clearly failing. The GM picks which.

name: Vanity
drive_trigger: When you show off in front of witnesses.
steady: Edge on Presence rolls when people are watching.
hook: Take +1 Heat any time you act in public.
breaking: You grandstand. Each turn you do the most impressive thing available, even if it leaves your team exposed.

name: Guilt
drive_trigger: When you take the blame or the pain for something that isn't your fault.
steady: Clear Bruised when you protect someone.
fraying: Advantage when protecting someone like the person you failed.
hook: You can't turn down someone who asks for help.
breaking: You shut down and lose your next turn. Then you confess something true to someone who shouldn't hear it.

name: Thrill
drive_trigger: When you pick the riskier option.
steady: Once per fight, Strain costs no Stress.
hook: You won't take cover or retreat.
breaking: You do the most dangerous thing in reach and drag someone into it with you.

name: Loyalty
drive_trigger: When you take a risk for a connection or a teammate.
steady: Edge on rolls made to protect, help or avenge one of your connections or a teammate.
hook: You won't leave anyone behind or sell anyone out.
breaking: You shield them from the truth or the law, even when they're wrong: you lie, hide evidence, or step between them and justice. Take +1 Heat.

name: Obsession
drive_trigger: When you chase your target past what's sensible.
steady: At the start of each Night, name one person or case as your target. Edge on rolls that move it forward.
fraying: +1 Harm on hits against your target.
hook: You ignore anything that isn't about the target.
breaking: You abandon the team or a civilian to chase the lead. The GM picks which.

name: Fear
drive_trigger: When you act despite being scared.
steady: Edge on the first roll you make in each fight.
fraying: Clear 1 Stress whenever an attack against you Misses.
hook: You overprepare and won't go in blind.
breaking: You run, or you strike first and hardest at the thing you're afraid of. The GM picks which.

name: Duty
drive_trigger: When you keep your word or follow your code at a cost.
steady: Edge on rolls to keep an oath, a promise or your code.
hook: You won't break your code, even when it's tactically dumb.
breaking: You follow the code into disaster, whoever it costs.
